{{Quote|&hellip;but I'm sure your planet is very nice, too.|Typical Corellian remark to their listeners after boasting about Corellia and Jonash e Solo's role in ending the Alsakan Conflicts|<ref name="SoF" />}}
'''Jonash e Solo''' was a [[Prince/Legends|Prince]]-[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] active by [[3017 BBY]]. By that time, the [[Seventeenth Alsakan Conflict|seventeeth]] of a fourteen-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long series of wars&mdash;known as the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]]&mdash;over [[Politics/Legends|political]] control of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was being waged between its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies.<ref name="EGTW" />

In 3017 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="EGTW" /> over the span of a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]],<ref name="SoF" /> [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] from Corellia, which had consistently pursued neutrality in the conflicts, defeated the [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of both [[Corellian privateer attack on Coruscant|Coruscant]] and [[Corellian privateer attack on Alsakan|Alsakan]]. In response, the Republic declared war on Corellia, but its forces quickly defeated those of the Republic,<ref name="EGTW" /> and on the floor of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on Coruscant,<ref name="SoF" /> e Solo dictated a [[Alsakan Conflicts peace treaty|peace treaty]] between Alsakan and Coruscant<ref name="EGTW" /> at the point of his [[Sword/Legends|sword]].<ref name="SoF" /> The treaty brought the Alsakan Conflicts to a conclusion,<ref name="EGTW" /> and millennia later, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] would commonly boast to other Core-worlders about the critical role Corellia and e Solo played in ending the wars.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jonash e Solo was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
